issue.title: test_fast_success_matches_inline hits the 8s soft ceiling under parallel check, passes in isolation
issue.description:
## Flake report

- **Test:** `tests/tool/test_inline_escalation.py::test_fast_success_matches_inline`
- **Repro:** full parallel `sase tool run check` / `just check` lane (the failure was on xdist gw8)

Relayed from phase sase-1io.7.6.2 note #4 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP, agent sase-1io.7.6.2--1, 2026-10-09). During that phase's `sase tool run check`, this node failed once with exit 124, the 8s soft-ceiling timeout, on worker gw8. The same node then passed in isolation on the working tree and on a clean base (2 passed each). The phase diff did not touch this test (`touched=false`). Fail rate: 1 parallel-lane failure, 0 isolation failures on both trees. The sibling node in the same check (`test_handoff_end_to_end_publishes_one_notification`, database-is-locked) is a different signature and is already tracked on sase-18t. Root cause of the ceiling timeout under load was not identified.
